scope: 'Core group_run vertical slice: create/list/detail runs, join and leave participants,

entities:
- name: Run
  fields:
  - name: id
    type: string
    required: true
    generated: true
  - name: title
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: datetime
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: meeting_location
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: distance
    type: string
    required: false
    default: null
  - name: pace_target
    type: string
    required: false
    default: null
  - name: route_notes
    type: string
    required: false
    default: null
  - name: participant_count
    type: integer
    required: true
  - name: participants
    type: list[string]
    required: true
    default: []
api:
  base_path: /api
  request_shapes:
    RunCreate:
      required:
      - title
      - datetime
      - meeting_location
      optional:
      - distance
      - pace_target
      - route_notes
    JoinRequest:
      required:
      - name
    LeaveRequest:
      required:
      - name
  endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /runs
    summary: create a run event
    request: RunCreate
    response: Run
    success_status: 201
    errors:
    - validation_error
  - method: GET
    path: /runs
    summary: list all runs
    response: list[Run]
  - method: GET
    path: /runs/{run_id}
    summary: get run details including participant list
    response: Run
    errors:
    - run_not_found
  - method: POST
    path: /runs/{run_id}/join
    summary: join a run with a participant name
    request: JoinRequest
    response: Run
    errors:
    - run_not_found
    - duplicate_participant
    - validation_error
  - method: POST
    path: /runs/{run_id}/leave
    summary: leave a run by participant name
    request: LeaveRequest
    response: Run
    errors:
    - run_not_found
    - participant_not_found
    - validation_error
  error_contract:
    shape: '{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}'
    codes:
      validation_error:
        http: 422
      run_not_found:
        http: 404
      duplicate_participant:
        http: 409
      participant_not_found:
        http: 404
      internal_error:
        http: 500
frontend:
  framework: react_vite
  routes:
  - path: /
    view: RunList
    purpose: browse upcoming runs showing title, datetime, location, and participant
      count; navigate to create or detail
    testids:
    - run-list-view
    - run-list
    - run-row
    - run-row-title
    - create-run-link
    - empty-state

      and optional (distance, pace_target, route_notes) fields
    testids:
    - run-create-view
    - run-create-form
    - run-title-input
    - run-datetime-input
    - run-location-input
    - run-distance-input
    - run-pace-input
    - run-notes-input
    - run-create-submit
    - create-error
  - path: /runs/:run_id
    view: RunDetail
    purpose: display full run details, participant list with count, and join/leave
      forms
    testids:
    - run-detail-view
    - run-title
    - run-participant-count
    - run-participant-list
    - join-form
    - join-name-input
    - join-submit
    - leave-form
    - leave-name-input
    - leave-submit
    - detail-error

  choice: Participant name uniqueness is case-insensitive; original display casing

    default recommendation: case-insensitive uniqueness'''

  choice: Leaving with a name not present on the run returns HTTP 404 with code PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND,
    not a 204 no-op
  warrant: PRD §5.5 — 'If participant name does not exist on the run, backend returns
    clear error (or no-op with clear response; choose one and document in QA handoff)'
- id: participants-as-flat-string-list
  choice: Participants are a flat list of name strings on the Run entity rather than
    a separate Participant entity
  warrant: PRD §5.4–5.5 — unauthenticated model; participant name is the sole identifier
    and no user identity exists
- id: run-id-is-opaque-string
  choice: Run IDs are opaque strings (UUID v4 at implementation); the API contract
    treats them as opaque identifiers with no format guarantee
  warrant: PRD §5.1 — 'generated id'; no external consumer parses or depends on the
    format
- id: capacity-field-excluded
  choice: 'Answer to the one open question (capacity-field-excluded), from the PRD
    (SIP-0109 §24ad; #1908 §3a): no manifest amendment. Build the core as the manifest
    declares it. PRD §4.1 makes expansion work conditional (''allowed only after core
    scope is stable and integration is working'') and §13 lists capacity limits as
    a later cycle''s item (''if not implemented as expansion''). In this campaign
    the expansion scope is what the increments deliver, one change request at a time
    (the objective). So capacity stays out of this calibration, and a later increment
    may propose it. No earlier answer covers the question. This is the narrowest answer
    consistent with the PRD and the manifest as authored, recorded as a judgement
    (the supervisor, the owner''s delegate).'
  warrant: 'answered at cyc_6d6b0d848596''s plan gate by human:005159fd-7461-45e4-b4f5-b2c9f868161b
    at 2026-10-04T16:58:21.020561+00:00; the question was: PRD §4.1 Tier 1 item 1
    proposes an optional capacity field. It is not declared in this manifest''s Run
    entity or RunCreate shape. Confirm whether a manifest amendment is required before
    implementing it, or defer to a post-MVP cycle (PRD §13 ''Capacity limits + waitlist'').'
provenance:
  mode: authored
  cycle_id: cyc_6d6b0d848596
  task_id: task-run_c2c74d06-003-development.author_manifest
  attempts: 1
  revisions: []
